predicate.label: director of organization
predicate.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit director office of, for or at organization or institution Y.
includes: functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y
ambiguous: abstract topic in place of the actual institution
predicate.notes: Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit director/co-director; functional directorship such as communications or research director within Y; historical office. Excludes: head/president/chair/executive alone; spokesperson/adviser/publisher/professor/member alone; performing or authorship alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: personal principal with omitted organization; abstract topic in place of the actual institution. Does not require sole chief control of the entire institution.

rationale: Director/co-director paths dominate; academic expertise, chairman and generic overseeing remain distinct.
